crewai.snippet:
import os
os.environ["CREWAI_TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT"] = "true"

from openobserve import openobserve_init
openobserve_init()

from openinference.instrumentation.crewai import CrewAIInstrumentor
CrewAIInstrumentor().instrument()
crewai.instruction: Paste these lines at the top of your app entrypoint, BEFORE importing CrewAI or the instrumentor. Order matters: openobserve_init() must run first so its TracerProvider is the one CrewAI sees. CREWAI_TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT=true disables CrewAI's built-in telemetry that conflicts with OTel.
crewai.verify_step: Call crew.kickoff() on any Crew. Then in OpenObserve, open Traces and filter by gen_ai_system=crewai.
